description: mix ci runs ex_dna --max-clones 0 on lib/ only (default paths: 30 files). mix ex_dna test finds 26 clones (21 exact, 5 renamed); some are kernel fixtures repeated on purpose. Add test/ to the ci alias (separate threshold or --ignore for intended fixtures), consider --literal-mode abstract and a lower --min-mass for helpers. Semantic duplicates stay a review concern. Done when a new copied helper in test/ fails mix ci.
title: CI gate for test drift: ex_dna over test/
